correctness.rationale: Unique positive-gap segmentation gives C_k(t)=P_S(t)((1-t)^{-1}-t^{k-1}); polynomial boundary word counts cannot raise entropy. Analyticity at q<1 and monotonicity imply qk>q and O(kq^{2k}) entropy expansion with explicit derivative. Stationary iid gap spacings q^{s+1} give maximal entropy and exact cylinder probability. Finite spectral tests verified 20 independent matrices and 15 large-k comparisons, not used as universal proof.
